about: How a townhouse differs from an apartment and a house

A townhouse is a house on several levels sharing walls with neighbouring units. Unlike an apartment it has its own engineering, a staircase and several floors; unlike a detached house it has party walls and the rules of the residential community. So the design decides from the start where the boiler room goes, how utilities run between floors, how to insulate party walls from noise and what works the community administration allows.

Townhouses are often sold “from the developer” with no finishes: then the renovation starts from rough works, as in a new-build apartment. If the unit already has a renovation, we start with demolition and a survey of the utilities.

Renovation from $550/m²: works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances separately, per estimate. Design project from $30/m², minimum $2,500; furnishing from $250/m². For a typical 150 m² unit on two or three levels the base calculation is 150 m² × $550. If CAS carries out the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.

faq: Who renovates townhouses in Kyiv turnkey?
CAS Development — a Kyiv design and renovation studio since 2016: design, engineering, finishes and furniture by one team, works by our own salaried staff. We work in Kyiv and the region.
How much does townhouse renovation cost per m²?
From $550 per m² — works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances separately, per estimate.
Do you renovate a townhouse from the developer with no finishes?
Yes, from the rough works: screed, plaster, utilities, boiler room, staircase — and all the way to furniture.
How do you insulate a townhouse from neighbours' noise?
Party walls are lined with sound insulation systems, and floors between levels get a floating screed. We put this into the design before finishing.
How long does townhouse renovation take?
The timeline is fixed in the contract after the design and estimate; it depends on area, number of levels and engineering scope.
12 months on completed works. Payment 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or by stages, starting from a 10% advance.
